subject: angol
title: An app that changed my everyday life
situation: A popular technology website has a forum where users share their experiences of apps and gadgets. This month's topic is "An app that changed my everyday life". Write a post for the forum.
situationHu: Egy technológiai oldal fórumán arról írnak a felhasználók, melyik alkalmazás változtatta meg a mindennapjaikat; írj bejegyzést.

modelAnswer.text:
I came across this app last winter, when I was preparing for my mid-year exams and felt hopelessly disorganised. It is a free study planner that lets you break big tasks into small steps, set reminders and track the time you spend on each subject.

Since I started using it, I have become far more organised. Every evening I spend five minutes planning the next day, so I always know where to start. It has also completely changed the way I revise: I work in 25-minute blocks with short breaks, and I have finally stopped leaving everything until the last minute.

The only drawback is that the free version is full of adverts, which is really distracting. It would be even better if it offered a cheap student subscription.

I'd highly recommend it to anyone who struggles with time management.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: mindhárom szempont kidolgozott – mi az alkalmazás és hogyan talált rá, két konkrét változás a napirendben (esti tervezés, 25 perces tanulási blokkok), végül egy hátrány (reklámok) és egy javítási ötlet.

Nyelvhelyesség: a present perfect pontosan jelzi a máig tartó változást (Since I started using it, I have become …; It has also completely changed …), a feltételes mondat pedig a javaslatot (It would be even better if it offered …).
Hangnem és szövegalkotás: félhivatalos, személyes fórumhang; a bekezdések a szempontokat követik, a zárómondat ajánlással kerekíti le a bejegyzést.
Szókincs: érdemes megtanulni: I came across this app when …, it lets you …, the only drawback is that …, leave everything until the last minute.
